name: arena-hero-lab
description: Deterministic simulation, benchmarking, research, replay, and leaderboard tooling for Arena Hero.

scripts.convert: uv run arena-hero-bench convert apps/leaderboard-web/scripts/input/results.json --output apps/leaderboard-web/src/data/bench.json --source-root apps/leaderboard-web
scripts.check:python: uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run ty check packages scripts apps/leaderboard-web/scripts/release.py && uv run pytest -q
scripts.check: pnpm run check:python && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm run check:privacy
